name: Commonwealth Faction Battlefleet
specialRuleText: At most one Airborne unit, excluding Flagships and Attachments. With a Polish-Lithuanian Airborne Flagship, up to four Polish-Lithuanian Airborne units may be included, excluding the Flagship.
At most one Underwater unit, excluding Flagships and Attachments.

battlefleetBonus.name: Acceptable Losses
battlefleetBonus.text: When a Commonwealth model in this Force is Crippled, its Admiral can declare this to be an Acceptable Loss as long as its unit still contains at least 1 Battle-Ready model (excluding attachments), and there are no models in the unit with 3 levels of Disorder. The unit makes a Group Crew Check. If this test is passed, the opposing Admiral does not score any Victory Points for Crippling the model.

name: Haydamak Battlefleet
specialRuleText: An **Akula Grand Submarine** with the **Ukrainian** trait can be allocated to this Battlefleet’s Ukrainian Flagship Element. If so, it gains the **Flagship** trait and does not count toward the maximum number of Akula Grand Submarine units this Battlefleet can contain.

battlefleetBonus.name: Zaporozhian Spirit
battlefleetBonus.text: When a Ukrainian unit in this Force makes an Attack action, its Admiral can discard a Victory & Valour Card before any dice are rolled. If they do so, the Action Roll is unaffected by Disorder.

battlefleetBonus.name: Terrors from Above
battlefleetBonus.text: At the start of their turn, this Battlefleet's Admiral may select a Commonwealth Airborne unit in their Force with the Incoming status and enact a Special Valour Effect. If successful, the unit loses Incoming and immediately activates, even if other units in this Force without Incoming have not yet Activated this Round. If unsuccessful, the unit does not Activate; the Admiral instead activates another unit in their Force that does not have Incoming.

name: Black Wolf Hunting Pack
specialRuleText: The Flagships must be Anastasia and/or Death Bringer. Neither can purchase a Fleet Doctrine.
At least half of the units in this Battlefleet must be Underwater. This Battlefleet cannot contain any Airborne units.
All units in this Battlefleet gain the Black Wolf trait if they do not already have it.

battlefleetBonus.name: Wolves upon the Fold
battlefleetBonus.text: When a friendly **Black Wolf** unit makes an Attack or Boarding action against a target with at least 2 levels of Disorder, its Admiral may re-roll any Blank results in the Action Roll.

name: Orlan-Belokhvost Battlefleet
specialRuleText: At least half of the units must have Ekranoplan or Hovercraft; exclude the Flagship and Attachments from this calculation.
Up to four Hovercraft units. No Polish-Lithuanian Airborne units.

battlefleetBonus.name: The White Death
battlefleetBonus.text: When this Force's Admiral activates a Commonwealth unit that has at least one model with the Depleted status, they can enact a Special Valour Effect. If successful, all models in this unit with Depleted lose this status.

name: Icemaker Battlefleet
specialRuleText: Up to two Flagship units. The second Flagship cannot purchase a Fleet Doctrine.
At most one Airborne unit, excluding Flagships and Attachments.
Every applicable model in a unit with a Cryo Generator upgrade option must purchase that upgrade.

battlefleetBonus.name: Advanced Cryo-Capacitors
battlefleetBonus.text: When this Battlefleet's Admiral declares that one of their units will make a Cryogenic Blast special action, they may discard a Victory & Valour Card. If they do so, this Action costs 0 Action Points. It still counts as a Special Action, so Participating models cannot Participate in another Cryogenic Blast during the same Activation.

name: Svyatogor Colossi Battlefleet
specialRuleText: This Battlefleet cannot contain any Airborne units.

battlefleetBonus.name: The Giant's Breath
battlefleetBonus.text: When making an Attack action in which at least one Participating Commonwealth Light Vessel model is within 6" of at least one friendly Commonwealth Colossus unit, any Blanks and Standard Counters in the Action Roll can be re-rolled. Attachments cannot trigger this Bonus.

name: Alliance Faction Battlefleet
specialRuleText: This Battlefleet can include at most one **Airborne** unit and/or one **Underwater** unit. Its **Flagship** and **Attachments** do not count toward this limit.

battlefleetBonus.name: Coordinated Support
battlefleetBonus.text: Once per Round, after an **Alliance** unit in this Force activates, its Admiral may enact a Special Valour Effect. If successful, another friendly Alliance unit within 8 inches that has not activated activates immediately, then gains Activated. No SRS Mission can be resolved between these two activations.

battlefleetBonus.name: Levant Surge
battlefleetBonus.text: When this Admiral activates a **Marine Levante** unit, they may declare that it makes a Levant Surge this Round. Mark it with a Special Effect token until the start of its next activation. While marked, its Maximum Speed is increased by 3 inches and it does not count as having Low Altitude.

battlefleetBonus.name: Naval Maniple
battlefleetBonus.text: All **Italian Patrol** units in this Force gain the Coordinated Defence and Decksweepers systems.

name: Barbudos Battlefleet
specialRuleText: A **Francisco Battlecruiser** or **Salvador Battlecruiser** can be allocated to this Battlefleet’s SUSA Flagship Element. If so, it gains the **Flagship** trait and does not count toward the maximum number of Francisco or Salvador units this Battlefleet can contain.

battlefleetBonus.name: Veteran Cadre
battlefleetBonus.text: When this Admiral activates a **SUSA** unit, they may immediately enact a Special Valour Effect. If successful, each model in the unit gains Boarding Party (X), where X is the unit’s Nerve value. If the unit scores at least one Success during a Boarding action this activation, its Admiral gains 3 Victory Points.

battlefleetBonus.name: Comunicação Network
battlefleetBonus.text: Each model in this Force with the **Portuguese** trait gains the Hydrophone Relay system.

name: Marina Pontificia Battlefleet
specialRuleText: This Battlefleet can include at most one **Airborne** unit and/or one **Underwater** unit. Its **Flagship** and **Attachments** do not count toward this limit.

battlefleetBonus.name: Splendor Dei
battlefleetBonus.text: This Battlefleet’s **Flagship** gains the Generator Ship system.

name: Crown Faction Battlefleet
specialRuleText: This Battlefleet can include at most one **Airborne** unit and/or one **Underwater** unit. Its **Flagship** does not count toward this limit.

battlefleetBonus.name: Lionhearted Crew
battlefleetBonus.text: When making a Crew Check or Group Crew Check for a **Crown** unit, this Admiral may discard a Victory & Valour Card from their hand instead of drawing the top card of their deck. The discarded card’s Value is used for the Crew Check.

name: Dominion Aegis Battlefleet
specialRuleText: This Battlefleet can include at most one **Airborne** unit and/or one **Underwater** unit. Its **Flagship** does not count toward this limit.

battlefleetBonus.name: Guardian Resonators
battlefleetBonus.text: If this Admiral declares they will employ Guardian Generators for a model within 5 inches of a friendly **Ceylon Guardian Platform**, they may re-roll Exploding Strike results in the Resistance Roll, in addition to any Blank results.

name: East India Privateers Battlefleet
specialRuleText: If this Battlefleet’s **Flagship** is an **Adventurer Grand Indiaman**, one **Palashi Indiaman** can be included by replacing its Flagship trait with Line. It must be allocated to a Line Element.

battlefleetBonus.name: Press the Advantage
battlefleetBonus.text: As long as this Admiral has more Victory Points than their opponent, they may re-roll any Blank results when making an Action Roll for an **EITC** or **Indian Raj** unit.

name: The Nautilus
specialRuleText: The Nautilus must be allocated to this Element and cannot have Attachments. When taken as part of a Crown Force, this Battlefleet does not count toward the number of Specialist Battlefleets that can be included.

name: The Lords Hood
specialRuleText: **The Lords Hood** is a **British Sabre Command Cruiser** unit with 3 models. It can take up to four Escort tokens at +10 points each, but cannot take Generator Hardpoints or Attachments.

battlefleetBonus.name: Dark Hand
battlefleetBonus.text: Once per Round, if a model from this unit is in the Play Area, this Admiral may automatically Deny a Valour Effect without discarding a card. If they do, each model in The Lords Hood gains 1 Disorder.

name: Imperium Faction Battlefleet
specialRuleText: This Battlefleet can include at most one **Airborne** unit and/or one **Underwater** unit. Its **Flagship** and **Attachments** do not count toward this limit.

battlefleetBonus.name: Inductorium
battlefleetBonus.text: When an **Imperium** unit declares an Attack action, it may attempt a Special Valour Effect after declaring contributing weapons. If successful, the Attack gains Blast (X), where X equals the number of contributing weapons with Arc (X) and/or Voltaic (X). Each Action Roll made against a Secondary Target gains 1 Bonus Die for each System Failure the model has.

battlefleetBonus.name: Strategic Vantage
battlefleetBonus.text: When determining Initiative at the start of the game, this Admiral may draw two Victory & Valour Cards and select the higher Value. When determining Initiative in later Ready Phases, if this Admiral chooses to Hold Their Nerve, they draw two Bonus Cards instead of one.

name: Ordo Teutonic Luminary Battlefleet
specialRuleText: This Battlefleet’s **Flagship** must be a **Konig Generator Ship** or **Hochmeister Vitruvian Colossus** with the Teutonic Command upgrade.

battlefleetBonus.name: Experimental Warfare
battlefleetBonus.text: Once per Round, when making a Repair Roll for a unit in this Force with the **Teutonic Construct** property, this Admiral may re-roll every die that is not showing an Exploding Strike.

name: Scions of Jutland Mercenary Battlefleet
specialRuleText: A Fleet Doctrine cannot be purchased for this Battlefleet’s **Flagship**. All units in this Battlefleet gain the **Scions of Jutland** trait if they do not already have it, and gain the Stoic property.

battlefleetBonus.name: Pack Hunters
battlefleetBonus.text: When making an Attack or Boarding action, a **Scions of Jutland** unit in this Force may re-roll Blanks or Counters in the Action Roll, up to the number of Negative Effect tokens on the Initial Target.

name: Empire Faction Battlefleet
specialRuleText: This Battlefleet can include at most two **Airborne** units and at most one **Underwater** unit. Its **Flagship** and **Attachments** do not count toward either limit.

battlefleetBonus.name: Jade Fury
battlefleetBonus.text: While an opposing unit contains one or more models with the Hazard Critical Damage Effect, it is Burning. When a Burning unit activates, its Admiral must make a Group Crew Check. If failed, each model gains 1 Disorder. If a Burning model gains a fourth Disorder, it suffers 1 Damage and Disorder spreads as normal.

name: Chita-Swarm Battlefleet
specialRuleText: This Battlefleet may include at most four **Underwater** units and cannot include **Airborne** units. Its **Flagship** and **Attachments** do not count toward these limits.
The first Escort token purchased for each unit in this Battlefleet costs only 5 points, rather than 10.

battlefleetBonus.name: Chita-Strike
battlefleetBonus.text: When a **Japanese** unit in this Force declares an Attack action where all contributing weapons have both Submerged and Torpedo, this Admiral may declare a Chita-Strike. They may discard any number of Escort tokens from the attacking unit; each token adds 3 Action Dice. Each token also adds Breach (1) to one contributing weapon.

name: Dragon's Wrath Battlefleet
specialRuleText: A **Tianlong Draconic Colossus** can be allocated to one of the Empire Draconic Elements even though this breaks the Flagship Limits and Duplicate Classes restrictions. A Battlefleet Doctrine cannot be purchased for this unit, even though it is a Flagship.

battlefleetBonus.name: Their Will Made Manifest
battlefleetBonus.text: Battle-ready **Draconic** models in this Force are Scoring Models.

name: Gwisin Silent-Strike Battlefleet
specialRuleText: This Battlefleet cannot include **Underwater** or **Surface** units. If your Force contains a Zhanmadao Battlefleet, this Battlefleet does not take up one of your Specialist Battlefleet slots.

battlefleetBonus.name: Cloud-Strike
battlefleetBonus.text: At the start of each Round’s Launch Phase, this Admiral may launch a single stack of 4 Doksori Fighter tokens as if launched by a Carrier unit at the centre of the Play Area.

name: Kagutsuchi Volcanic Battlefleet
specialRuleText: This Battlefleet can include at most two **Airborne** units and at most two **Underwater** units. Its **Flagship** and **Attachments** do not count toward these limits.

During Force Selection, models in this Battlefleet add Magma Cast Generator to their Generator options at +45 points. If a model already has a Magma Cast Generator option, its cost is unchanged. Its Flagship must have a Magma Cast Generator or Magma Tower Generator.

battlefleetBonus.name: Monument of Fire
battlefleetBonus.text: In the End Phase of each Round, during Complete Objectives, this Admiral may discard a Victory & Valour Card. If they do, they score Victory Points equal to the Mass of the largest Magma Formation wholly in their opponent’s half of the Play Area.

name: Yamata No Orochi Abyssal Battlefleet
specialRuleText: This Battlefleet cannot include **Airborne** or **Surface** units.

battlefleetBonus.name: Abyssal Terror
battlefleetBonus.text: When making an Attack action with an **Empire Underwater** unit with the Surfacing status, this Admiral may discard a Victory & Valour Card at the start of the Count Hits step. If they do, all Standard Counters in the Action Roll become Standard Strikes.

name: Zhanmadao Battlefleet
specialRuleText: This Battlefleet cannot include **Underwater** or **Surface** units.

battlefleetBonus.name: Castles in the Sky
battlefleetBonus.text: All **Empire Support Skyfortress** units in this Force gain Cloud Dive until the end of the first Round.

name: Sultanate Faction Battlefleet
specialRuleText: This Battlefleet can include at most one **Airborne** unit and/or one **Underwater** unit. Its **Flagship** and **Attachments** do not count toward this limit.

battlefleetBonus.name: Superior Weaponry
battlefleetBonus.text: Once per Round, when declaring Contributing Weapons for an Attack action made by a **Sultanate** unit in this Force, this Admiral can declare Superior Weaponry. For the duration of this Action, all Contributing weapons with Piercing (X), Precise (X), or Structural Failure (X) increase all Firepower values by the highest X value among those Qualities. Firepower values listed as "-" are unaffected.

battlefleetBonus.name: Aethernauts
battlefleetBonus.text: If an **Order** unit from this Force Departs through a Portal, its Admiral can attempt to enact a Special Valour Effect at the end of the Movement Step. If denied, the unit returns to Reserve as normal. If successful, the unit is immediately Deployed through another Portal in the Play Area as though it had just arrived from Reserve.

battlefleetBonus.name: Serpens Caput
battlefleetBonus.text: Once per Round, when declaring Contributing Weapons for an Attack action made by an **Airborne Patrol** unit in this Force where the Initial Target is in the Fore arc of all Participating models, this Admiral can reveal and discard a Victory & Valour Card. If they do, add Bonus Dice to the Action Pool equal to the card Value.

name: Crimson League Privateers
specialRuleText: A Fleet Doctrine cannot be purchased for this Battlefleet’s **Flagship**.
All units in this Battlefleet gain the **Crimson League** trait.

This is a **Mercenary Battlefleet** and can be fielded as a Specialist Battlefleet in a Force created using a different ORBAT. Its units must still be chosen from the Sultanate ORBAT, except for the optional Enlightened Automata unit.

battlefleetBonus.name: Peer in Residence
battlefleetBonus.text: Whenever this Battlefleet’s Admiral Activates a **Crimson League** unit in their Force, they can remove a single System Failure Critical Damage Effect from one Battle-Ready model in that unit.

name: Union Faction Battlefleet
specialRuleText: This Battlefleet can include at most two **Airborne** units and at most one **Underwater** unit. **Mainstay Classes**, its **Flagship**, and **Attachments** do not count toward this limit.

battlefleetBonus.name: Give 'em Hell
battlefleetBonus.text: Before declaring a Broadside action with a **Union** unit, this Admiral may discard a Victory & Valour Card. Each Exploding Strike in the subsequent Broadside Roll allows another Action Die to be rolled as if it were an Action Roll. If the active unit is **Airborne**, it gains Broadside Cascade for the duration of the Action. At the end of the Action, each model whose batteries Contributed gains 1 Disorder and cannot Rally in the subsequent Consolidation Phase.

name: Freedom Battlefleet
specialRuleText: This Battlefleet can include at most one **Airborne** unit and at most one **Underwater** unit. **Mainstay Classes**, its **Flagship**, and **Attachments** do not count toward this limit.

battlefleetBonus.name: Plant the Flag
battlefleetBonus.text: In the Complete Objectives step of the End Phase, this Admiral scores 4 Victory Points for every Territory where they have more Landing Party tokens than their opponent, as long as that Territory is within 10 inches of a friendly unit with the **Union** and **Platform** traits.

name: Manifest Destiny Battlefleet
specialRuleText: This Battlefleet’s **Flagship** must be an **America Special Operations Vessel** or a **Senator Command Cruiser** unit.
This Battlefleet can include at most one **Airborne** unit and at most one **Underwater** unit. **Mainstay Classes**, its **Flagship**, and **Attachments** do not count toward this limit.

battlefleetBonus.name: Forward Depot
battlefleetBonus.text: This Battlefleet’s **Flagship** gains the Stockpile (3) property and Repair Facilities (1) system.

name: Honorable Eclipse Company Mercenary Battlefleet
specialRuleText: A Fleet Doctrine cannot be purchased for this Battlefleet’s **Flagship**.
This is a **Mercenary Battlefleet** and can be fielded as a Specialist Battlefleet in a Force created using a different ORBAT. Its units must still be chosen from the Union ORBAT.

battlefleetBonus.name: HEC Contractors
battlefleetBonus.text: Every model in this Battlefleet gains the Descend property.

name: Enlightened Faction Battlefleet
specialRuleText: This Battlefleet can contain a maximum of one **Airborne** unit and/or one **Underwater** unit. The Battlefleet’s **Flagship** does not count towards this limit.

battlefleetBonus.name: Enlightened Science
battlefleetBonus.text: In the End Phase of each Round, this Admiral removes one Action Die from their Localised Anomaly Pool.

name: ESCF Battlefleet
specialRuleText: This Battlefleet can contain a maximum of two **Airborne** units and a maximum of one **Underwater** unit. The Battlefleet’s **Flagship** and units fielded as **Attachments** do not count toward either of these limits.

battlefleetBonus.name: Multiple Manufacturers
battlefleetBonus.text: This Admiral can purchase two Battlefleet Doctrines for this Battlefleet’s Flagship: one Driven by the Peer and one Constructed by the Forge. The cheapest one is purchased at no cost. This does not prevent the Admiral from choosing a Constructed by the Forge Doctrine for another Flagship, despite the normal limit of one per Force.

battlefleetBonus.name: Calculated Extrapolation
battlefleetBonus.text: Each Round, during the Draw Cards step of the Ready Phase, this Admiral gains one Bonus Card.

name: Autonomous Research Group
specialRuleText: This Battlefleet can contain a maximum of one **Airborne** unit. The Battlefleet’s **Flagship** does not count toward this limit.

battlefleetBonus.name: Self-Refining Behaviour Protocols
battlefleetBonus.text: All **Automata** units in this Force gain the **Stoic** property.

name: Cetacean Operations Groups
specialRuleText: At least half of the units in this Battlefleet must have the **Physeter Support Hub** or **SRS (Orca Constructs)** property.

battlefleetBonus.name: All Hail the Whale!
battlefleetBonus.text: At the end of the Deployment step, this Admiral gains 6 Physeter Construct tokens. They can then allocate these tokens between units in their Force, with a maximum of 3 tokens per unit.
